lessons.title: Cooking Steps, Recipes & Kitchen Tools
lessons.description: First, second, then, after that, finally and cooking verbs

questions.rule:
- Process: First (İlk olarak), Second (İkinci olarak), Then (Daha sonra), After that (Ondan sonra), Finally (Son olarak).
- Verbs: Chop (Doğramak), Peel (Soymak), Boil (Kaynatmak), Fry (Kızartmak), Bake (Fırında pişirmek), Grate (Rendelemek).
questions.examTip: MEB LGS sorularında yemek tarifi aşamalarının sırası (First, Then, Finally) sorulur!

questions.prompt: "_____ peel the potatoes. Second, slice them into thin pieces." Boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
questions.explanation: İşlemin ilk adımı olduğu için "First" (İlk olarak) kullanılır.

questions.prompt: "Bake" means cooking in an oven without direct flame (Fırında pişirmek).
questions.explanation: Bake fırında kek, ekmek vb. pişirmektir.

questions.prompt: You need a grater to _____ the cheese.
Which tool do you use to fry eggs?
"Pour" means adding liquid into a bowl or pan (Dökmek / Boşaltmak).
Put the pasta into _____ water for 10 minutes.
Match kitchen verbs with their Turkish meanings:
"What are the ingredients of the cake?" sorusunun cevabı hangisi olabilir?
questions.explanation: "Ingredients" malzeme demektir: Un, şeker, yumurta ve süt.

lessons.title: The Internet & Safety Rules Exam 🏆
lessons.description: LGS exam questions about internet safety, vocabulary and dialogs

questions.rule:
- Do not share your personal information or passwords with strangers.
- Do not meet online friends in real life without your parents.
- Do not open unknown files or links.
- Refuse unknown friend requests.
questions.examTip: MEB sorularında internet güvenlik kurallarına uymayan kişi veya davranış sorulur!

questions.prompt: Which of the following is an internet safety rule?
options: Do not share your password with anyone
Share your home address with everyone
questions.explanation: Şifreni kimseyle paylaşmamak temel güvenlik kuralıdır.

questions.prompt: "Download" means getting files from the internet to your computer.
You need an internet _____ to connect to websites.
If someone is cyberbullying you, what should you do first?
questions.explanation: Siber zorbalıkta aileye veya öğretmene haber verilmelidir.

questions.prompt: A strong password should include letters, numbers and special symbols.
questions.explanation: Güçlü şifre harf, rakam ve sembol içerir.

questions.prompt: I sent you an email with a file in the _____ .
"I use the internet mostly to practice English and read science articles." What is this person doing?
options: Playing online video games all day
questions.explanation: İngilizce pratiği ve bilimsel makaleler eğitimsel (educational) amaçlıdır.
